_note: Copy to hiring/first-month/config.json and fill it. structure has no default: ask the founder contractor, eor or entity before the offer is written. pay.transfer_fee is founder, hire or split. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; a Monday start is best. Every level string in systems[] starts with None, View, Edit or Full; the rest of the line is free text. plan.py reads the outcomes from criteria.md (lines 'By day N: ...') and the five tasks from task-log.md; 'outcomes' ([{"by_day": 14, "outcome": "...", "done": "..."}]) is used only when criteria.md has none; 'five_tasks' replaces task-log.md when it is not empty. 'day30_extra' adds rows to the day-30 check-in. Per system, 'login' (default Personal account) and 'two_factor' (default authenticator app) show on the access page. No real credentials in this file, ever.

pay.rail_note: Wise, Payoneer, PayPal, or Deel when you want the paperwork done. Fees change; check each one's live calculator before the first payment.

raise._note: A common pattern is ten to fifteen percent at six months and again at twelve. It is a pattern, not a rule. You set the numbers; the letter prints them.

first_deliverable: The first of the five task maps, written step by step, with the time it takes and what breaks when it is wrong. Finished by Friday of week one.

systems.name: Seller Central
systems.owner: The seller account stays under the founder as primary user. The hire gets a secondary user on their own email.
systems.grant_via: Settings, User Permissions, invite by email
systems.month1: Edit: Catalog (each change approved by the founder). View: Inventory, Reports
systems.month3: Edit: Catalog, Inventory, Advertising, Reports. View: Orders, only once the founder approves it (it shows buyer names and addresses)
systems.never: Administrator, Settings, Account Info, bank and deposit methods, tax, User Permissions
systems.notes: Two-step verification on an authenticator app, not SMS. Review permissions every six months and at every role change. Agencies go through Authorized Partners, never a user login.

systems.name: Google Workspace
systems.owner: Company domain. Super admin stays the founder. The hire gets their own mailbox on the company domain.
systems.grant_via: Admin console, Users, add user; Drive sharing per folder
systems.month3: Edit: Operations, Content and Launches drives; shared calendar
systems.never: Super admin, billing, domain and security settings
systems.notes: Two-step verification enforced for the account. Company mailbox only; nothing on a personal Gmail.

systems.name: Password manager
systems.owner: Team plan owned by the founder. The hire gets their own private vault plus read access to shared vaults per area.
systems.grant_via: Team admin, invite member, assign vaults
systems.week1: View: own vault plus the Content vault
systems.month1: View: Content, Amazon and Community vaults
systems.month3: View: Content, Amazon, Community and Ads vaults
systems.never: Team owner or admin, the Finance vault
systems.notes: Set up before the offer goes out. One shared vault per system area. One-off secrets go through an expiring share. Nothing in WhatsApp or email, ever.

day30_extra.expected: One expected result you added after the decision, in plain words.
day30_extra.evidence: Where you will look for it.
